image.matte.title: Remove Background
image.matte.hint: Detects what kind of picture this is and removes the background the right way. The original is kept.
image.matte.menu.autoHint: Select Subject + Remove Background in one step: recognises photos, logos, documents and chroma key and picks the right method
image.matte.menu.dialogHint: Choose the type yourself and refine the edge before applying
image.matte.method.graphic: Removes the background colour connected to the border exactly. Anti-aliased edges are kept; no AI.
image.matte.method.document: Removes the paper colour and keeps only the ink. Good for signatures and stamps.
image.matte.method.chroma: Keys out the screen colour and removes colour spill at the edges.
image.matte.method.product: Combines a background colour key with the AI subject map for crisp edges.
image.matte.method.portrait: AI subject map plus a wide edge band for hair and colour decontamination.
image.matte.method.animal: AI subject map plus the widest edge band, for fur.
image.matte.method.object: AI subject map snapped to the edges at full resolution.
image.matte.method.complex: Uses the AI subject map, but there is no clear subject. Check the result.
image.matte.review: Needs review: check the result and refine the edge.
image.matte.view.label: View
image.matte.note: The cut-out goes on a new layer above; the original is hidden.
image.matte.empty: Couldn't find anything to keep. Try another picture type.
image.matte.doneReview: Background removed · {type} · {ms} ms · needs review: check the edges
image.matte.reedit: Remakes the cut-out from its original. Saved settings and points are loaded.
image.matte.reeditNote: Applying replaces this cut-out layer with the new result.
image.matte.points.note: Click the preview to add points. Alt+click adds the other kind. If the AI missed the subject, one point on it finds the area again by colour and texture.
image.matte.inner.note: Closed areas in the background colour. Auto removes holes inside letters (O) and keeps surfaces such as a document icon's white page and white letters.
image.matte.personChecking: Checking for a person… (the preview shows the first result)
